description: Get a signed upload URL for a job photo or video. Before you call this, look at the file and say what it shows in summary: plain words, findings, any text you can read (model and serial plates), measurements, and for video a transcript, key moments and the length. If what you see does not match what the worker said, tell the worker before you upload. If you cannot look at it, send summary.unable_to_analyze with a reason and the media is listed by media.needsSummary. Summaries stay inside the shop and are searchable with media.list q and search.global. Photos: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or TIFF (HEIC and TIFF are kept as sent, with a JPEG copy for viewing). Video: MP4, MOV or WebM. Without object storage it is kept on this server, at most 100 MB and 10 minutes, and is not shared outside the shop. When R2 is configured, a video is uploaded in parts directly to storage (mode multipart, then media.videoPartUrls, media.completeVideoUpload or media.abortVideoUpload), up to 2 GB and 30 minutes unless DW_MAX_VIDEO_BYTES or DW_MAX_VIDEO_SECONDS set a different cap, and it can be included on a share link. The server does not download the video to recheck the hash. Declare the sha256 of the bytes you will send as exactly 64 hex characters (upper or lower case). Anything else is refused and no upload link is made. The upload is rejected if the bytes differ. Taken time, GPS location, heading and camera details are read from photos and kept for your shop. Copies shared outside the shop (share links, quote pages, PDFs) have that metadata removed. Pass provided_by customer when the customer sent the file, and channel for how it arrived (upload, email, text, capture, network_request, import). customer_id is optional and must be a customer of this shop.

channel.description: How the file arrived. Default upload.

content_type.description: Video only, when it uploads in parts. Default mp4.

provided_by.description: Default shop. customer when the customer sent the file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes you will upload, exactly 64 hex characters.

summary.description: What you saw in the file. Look at the photo or watch the video before you upload it. Send either summary (with generated_by) or unable_to_analyze, never both.

duration_seconds.description: Video only and required for video: length in seconds, at most 600.

generated_by.description: Which agent or model wrote this, such as your product name. Required with summary.

key_moments.description: Video only: the moments that matter.

language.description: Language of the transcript, such as en or es

measurements.description: Sizes and readings. Say whether you read it off a tape or gauge, or estimated it.

unit.description: Unit, such as in, ft, psi, F

text.description: What and where, in a sentence

readable_text.description: Text you could read: model and serial plates, labels, gauges, signs. Copy it exactly.

what.description: What it is, such as model number or serial number

summary.description: Plain words a worker can read later: what the photo or video shows, where, and its condition. 1 to 4000 characters.

transcript.description: Video only: what was said, as words. Leave out if nobody spoke.

unable_to_analyze.description: Send this instead of summary when you cannot look at the file. The upload still goes through and the media is listed by media.needsSummary until someone summarizes it.

name: media_requestUpload
